svg.text: Where primes land: the same primes on different wheels
top row = powers of two (octal→hex is just 2× finer); bottom row = primorial bases (fewer, genuinely tighter corridors)
Each dot is a prime ≤ 4096 on spoke (p mod base), radius growing with p. Colour = octal corridor (p mod 8): note red = {1,9}, etc. split across two hex spokes.
